title: a shaped ticket answers its FIXME on the entry
intention: A shaped (outcomes) ticket kicked into FIXME answers each entry on the entry itself, through a build_inspector door, and the FIXME gate counts that answer, so the ticket can cross out of FIXME without a decisions line its plan shape forbids.
why: Measured 2026-11-18 on 78a600419a21: kicked into FIXME at PROVED (hollow_evidence_absent), it could not leave. crossing_fixme counts only decisions with step 'FIXME n'; the cast door's _shape_lacks refuses decisions beside outcomes, and cairn rehearse --decide refuses 'outcomes[1] has no claim'. No door answers FIXME for a shaped plan.
traces_to: Law 8 (prove, then trust): a shaped ticket refused at PROVED must be able to answer and re-cross, or the only moves are plaster (writing past the shape check) or paralysis; Law 9: the red is fixed, not walked around.
how: In cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py: answer_fixme(ticket, n, text, by) writes fixme[n-1].answer={text,by,at} into the ticket's state file through ticket_file.write_state (the artifact door), refusing an absent entry, a blank text or no fixme list; crossing_fixme counts an entry's answer dated at or after the latest kick-back, beside the legacy FIXME n decisions; _main gains --answer-fixme <id> <n> <text>. Red-first proof cairn/machines/build_inspector/proofs/test_a_shaped_ticket_answers_its_fixme.py.

out: the rehearse verb (a later ticket, Q#103 one component)
